cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 14 days (336 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description: The Aquila 44 is a pure bred power catamaran with a fresh evolution of classic boating traditions. Efficiency in design and performance compliment her luxurious living. She features 3 cabins, 3 heads, spacious salon and galley and extensive flybridge.
